reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /collect draft output with Jacob Kennedy
review: ROOM CORRECTED FROM play TO battlestation. Every one of the 34 landed in play, and that was not a classification, it was the STORE'S OWN FALLBACK ROOM: the classifier matched nothing and _scene.js dropped each product into the registry's room. Mouse skates and grip tape at a mean of $12.84 are desk goods. Play is 'games, keys and the things you actually play'.
That is worth naming as a pattern, not a one-off: a room breakdown showing 100% in the store's own room is the shape of a fallback, not of a fit. Check the products before believing it.
Empty include: a list of ['mouse','phone'] would drop the single untyped row for nothing.
Two products are unpriced. They will show without a price rather than with a wrong one.
